Its durable material holds strong in all sorts of weather, which has made it a favorite among travelers.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== The Traveler's Saddle is a type of [[Saddle]] and [[Horse Gear]]. It can be obtained from a pair of [[Treasure Chest]]s that appear when the [[Link]] (Rider) [[amiibo]] is scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. One of the Treasure Chests will contain the Traveler's Saddle, while the other Chest will contain the [[Traveler's Bridle]]. Once obtained, the Traveler's Saddle will appear in Link's [[Key Item]] [[Inventory]]. Link can equip it to any [[Horse]] he has a maximum [[Bond]] with by talking to specific workers at [[Highland Stable]], [[Outskirt Stable]], [[South Akkala Stable]], or [[Woodland Stable]].{{Cite|Change to {{Color BotW|Red|Traveler's Saddle}}?|Canni|BotW}} However, like other [[Saddle]]s, they cannot be used by [[Epona]] or the [[Giant Horse]].{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out her {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? Actually, this horse is different from any I've ever seen before. My, she's so lovely and graceful... I'm sorry, but I'm pretty sure this little lady would absolutely hate it if you changed her mane or gear. I'm so sorry about that.|Canni|BotW}}{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out its {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? My goodness, that's no pony, is it? It's so big! I'm sorry, but I don't think I have any {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} that'd fit such a large horse, and I bet it wouldn't like its {{Color BotW|Blue|mane}} handled... I'm so sorry about that.|Canni|BotW}} Traveler's Saddles were designed for comfort and hold strong throughout all sorts of [[Weather]], which has lead to them being favored by travelers. In his [[Memory|Recovered Memories]], Link is shown to have a Traveler's Bridle and Traveler's Saddle equipped to his Horse before the second [[Great Calamity]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Horse Gear * Saddle * Traveler's Bridle }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Horse Gear, Saddles, Traveler's Gear |items= BotW, TotK |key-items= BotW, TotK }}
